options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Victory condition for the game.
Final Boss: Defeat the Black Jewel after collecting a set amount of Big Key Fragments
Nintendo Consoles: Collect the 4 Nintendo Consoles in the game (NES, Nintendo64, GameBoy Advance and Nintendo Gamecube)
Both: complete both of the above options
options.doc_html: Victory condition for the game. Final Boss: Defeat the Black Jewel after collecting a set amount of Big Key Fragments Nintendo Consoles: Collect the 4 Nintendo Consoles in the game (NES, Nintendo64, GameBoy Advance and Nintendo Gamecube) Both: complete both of the above options

options.name: Big Key Fragment Requirement
options.doc:
How many Big Key Fragments are given on start?
Recommended: 2 for a large pool of checks, 0 for a small or solo playthrough, set to 0 by default

options.name: Ending Type
options.doc:
How many spritelings are needed for goal completion
Silver ending (21) by default, you may change to other endings here:
Plant: 0-1
Wooden: 2-10
Stone: 11-20
Silver: 21-30
Golden: 31-39
Treasure: all 40
or set your own!

options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: ring_link
options.doc:
Games that support ringlink will be able to send and retrieve 'rings' sent from another ringlink game.

'Rings' in the context of Warioworld will be Coins.
